name: lending-irm-curve
description:
Walks the borrow-rate-vs-utilization curve for the default princeps lending market's IrmParams. Samples 11 utilization points (0%, 10%, …, 100%) and evaluates `princeps_lending::compute_borrow_rate` at each — the same kernel function the on-chain accrual loop uses every block. Useful for asking: where is the kink? How much steeper does the slope get above it? At what utilization does the rate become punishing enough to discourage further borrowing?

The default market: base 0, slope-below-kink = RAY/10_000, slope-above-kink = RAY/1_000 (10x steeper), kink at 80%. Pure-Rust dispatch in v2 — no Reth, no Malachite, no validator.
headline: 11-point IRM curve sweep; rate climbs ~10x steeper above the 80% kink — the design knob a prime broker tunes to discourage utilization stress.

steps.explanation: Sweep utilization 0% → 100% in 10% steps and compute the borrow rate at each point with the default lending market's IrmParams.
